steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Cough...!
You're pulled out of the water. It takes a long time to readjust after leaving the deep sea. The air is so unfamiliar it's almost suffocating.

Your last remaining companion keeps you afloat. She slowly parts the waters, pulling over some floating debris and pushing you on top of it with her last bit of strength. She cups your face with both hands, keeping you from slipping back under the waves.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Hold on tight, don't let go... It's over now.
Pylgia tries to give you some warmth, but her skin is as cold as the sea. Her touch is your anchor, connecting you to a world you are sensing anew.
The Illusory Moon is gone. A gray, overcast sky hangs low, pressing down against the leaden sea. Cold, briny. Your senses return one by one to the rocking of the waves.
The nightmare is over. You have escaped the Abyss.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...Yes, we're back.
She grasps your hand and forces a wan smile.
Then, you hear a distant shout.

steps.speaker: Distant Figure
steps.content: Hey—! Can you hear us?
A small boat appears on the rolling waves. Someone's waving frantically. You can't make out their face, but you know...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...It's the expedition team... They found us, we're saved...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia... we can go home. Together...
The hand you're clutching suddenly feels wrong. Cold and soft, almost boneless. This is not the hand of a human.
At some point, her skin has turned transparent again, veins visible underneath. Coral-like tendrils branch from her body, swaying gently with the waves.
And below the surface, the dark waters conceal her shifting form.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: No... It's not supposed to be like this... We both made it back, so why won't she let you go?! Is it Shin? Is this her doing again?!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Pylgia, hold onto me! Don't go! We escaped the Abyss together, it won't control you!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're human! You have friends, they're coming for you now!! Don't listen to her!
I told you I'd be back...
Pylgia looks at you, then at her own body. At last, she raises her arms and wraps you in her embrace.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...It's alright... I know who I am, and it won't drag me down. This is my own choice...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'm choosing this body. It's the only way I can slip quietly into the Abyss... to bring our companions home...

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Do you remember them? You don't want them to be trapped in the dark forever, do you...?
[Flashback Sequence]
You remember the ones imprisoned in the Abyss.

Not the fanatic Shin, but the others... the ones who, even after endless torment, after losing their bodies, their voices, their dignity and reason, still fought to awaken you from your trance. The ones who exhausted everything they had to give you a ray of light.
They boarded that ship of death, setting sail for the Abyss to rescue you and Pylgia, lost at sea. They knew nothing of what awaited them, and even if they had, they would never have regretted it.
Neither you nor Pylgia could ever abandon them.
You're still for a long moment, before slowly raising your hands to hold Pylgia tight. You don't want to let go, but you know... this is farewell.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Can they... can they still be saved?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Of course... They're so strong, they fought so hard. You saw it... They just need someone to lend them a hand. I'm the best choice.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: It's too dangerous. We both know it wants you more than anyone else. Your presence would only excite it, and that would make things harder.

steps.speaker: Option
options: Then I'll let the others know.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: If you tell them, they'll get worried. They'll come after me. And I don't want to lose anyone else...
Her pale smile becomes infinitely gentle. As if in response to you, her inhuman skin gains a touch of warmth, like a final comfort, a reluctant farewell.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Don't be afraid, my child... This time, no matter what I become, no matter where I'm taken, I'll never forget where I belong, and I won't give up on returning to my companions.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: ...Because you've already shown me the way home. I've walked that path once. I won't forget it again. And I'll never be alone.

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: I'll bring them back, just like you brought me back. When I do... you'll be there to welcome me home, won't you?

steps.speaker: Pylgia
steps.content: Now... my brave guide, lend me your courage, and wish me... a safe journey.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I'll come for you... Wait for me.

steps.content: [Scene darkens, 2 seconds] Process sound effects

Her hands tighten one last time, then suddenly let go. The waves give a gentle push, and you're taken away from her warm embrace. The cold sea wind jolts your eyes open. The dream shatters. Before you, the surface of the ocean is empty, the waves having erased every trace of hers.
The debris carries you on, until you fall into the arms of others.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team
steps.content: Got you!

steps.speaker: Rescue Team
steps.content: Good heavens, what are you doing out here alone? Don't you know how dangerous this place is? The sea's claimed enough lives! You're our important guide. What if something happened to you?

steps.speaker: Option
options: I... the Deep Dive unit, they...

steps.content: The rescue team pauses, exchanging glances. Their expressions grow heavy, and they struggle to find their words.

steps.speaker: Rescue Team
steps.content: So it was for Shin and the others...

steps.speaker: Rescue Team
steps.content: Listen, ${PlayerName}, the truth is...
[Background slowly darkens]
You're brought back to shore and awakened by Schorl. But for the next several nights, until the Illusory Moon tide fully recedes, you find yourself dreaming of this place.
Here, you see the small station built by the expedition's Deep Dive unit. You learn...
[Slowly fade to black]

During the third week of an Illusory Moon cycle, Deep Dive Unit One was conducting a routine mission to retrieve equipment when they encountered an accident. Three divers—Pylgia, Ragnar, and Dale—lost contact.
Two days after Unit One went missing, Deep Dive Unit Two departed on a rescue mission. Seven days later, their vessel lost contact. The entire crew of eleven, including their leader, Professor Shin, never returned. Multiple rescue attempts by other teams were fruitless.

One month later, all fourteen members of the Deep Dive units were declared dead.

The Deep Dive station, having lost its equipment, vessels, and most importantly, its people, was abandoned.
The expedition team erected a memorial beside the station, carving on the tombstone the names of the Deep Dive unit members.

Their sacrifice serves as a warning:
The time has not yet come.
Do NOT chase the Illusory Moon.
Do NOT approach the Abyss.
Only the young guide refused to accept the truth. He insisted that he could hear the Deep Dive unit's voices, that Pylgia was still searching for her companions, that they would all come home.
steps.female_content: Only the young guide refused to accept the truth. She insisted that she could hear the Deep Dive unit's voices, that Pylgia was still searching for her companions, that they would all come home.

steps.content: ...Every day, he went to the leaden shore, waiting beside his companions' graves for the departed to return.
steps.female_content: ...Every day, she went to the leaden shore, waiting beside her companions' graves for the departed to return.

steps.content: [Fade in to Small CG 1]
You keep watch at the station and find that woman's notes.
The journal is filled with arcane language and theory, enigmatic models and formulas, too complex for ordinary minds.
Perhaps it also hides a madness beyond normal perception.
[Small CG 2, Focus on Tombstone]
Or perhaps all of this is just a nightmare fabricated by the Illusory Moon to deceive you.
Perhaps... somewhere in your subconscious, you want those days of darkness, that crushing despair... to be nothing but a dream. Something conjured by your proximity to the Abyss.
Everything before you grows thin. This tide cycle is nearing its end. Next time, you'll wake in another corner of history.
Just as you think this, the comms device in the small shack crackles to life.
[Static sound effect]
Uh... her notes? I'm not sure. Maybe you guys should...
Okay then. I'll just grab whatever I find. You guys can figure it out.
The voice gets closer. It's not coming from the radio, but...
[Small CG 3] Medium Shot
Someone's coming up the slope. A young man with wild hair that looks like a messy bird's nest.
He stumbles as he walks.
It's way too complicated. I don't understand it. You guys find the answers. I...
[Small CG 4] Allow sufficient pause time
[Pause 1s]
[Small CG 5] Pause for two seconds, sound of ocean waves
This is your first meeting after a long goodbye. As the Illusory Moon fades, your consciousness recedes.
[Screen dims]
Until the very end, you never get a clear look at his face.
